Q8137.reason: Act of State means domestic courts will not sit in judgment on a foreign State's public acts done in its own territory; A describes absolute immunity and C states the opposite.

Q5849.reason: Saying the records were kept regularly does not meet FRE 803(6) or authentication, so the court must require a fuller foundation on how the records were made and their reliability.

Q5779.reason: An unused peripheral cannula is standardly flushed with 0.9% saline about every 8 hours, and also before and after each use, to keep it patent.
